security_audit.summary: All 33 static findings are false positives caused by constrained command examples, Markdown fences, temporary-directory use, documentation links, or misclassified LibreOffice commands. Semantic review found unsafe process termination, an unauthenticated local UNO listener, and unescaped template substitution.

remediation.issue: The troubleshooting command terminates every soffice.bin process, including unrelated sessions with unsaved documents.
remediation.suggestion: Identify the specific headless process and request confirmation before terminating it.

remediation.issue: The UNO example opens a local socket without describing authentication or multi-user host risks.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users about local access, restrict permissions, and stop the listener immediately after automation.

remediation.issue: Template values are inserted directly into content.xml without XML escaping.
remediation.suggestion: Use an XML or ODF library to insert text nodes and validate the generated document.

semantic_findings.title: Broad Process Termination Can Cause Data Loss
semantic_findings.description: The troubleshooting guidance runs killall soffice.bin, which can terminate unrelated LibreOffice sessions and discard unsaved work.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The command explicitly targets every process with this executable name rather than the specific headless service.

semantic_findings.title: Unauthenticated Local UNO Service
semantic_findings.description: The troubleshooting command opens a localhost UNO socket without access controls, potentially allowing other local processes to control LibreOffice.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The listener configuration is explicit, but the actual exposure depends on host isolation and local user trust.

semantic_findings.title: Unescaped XML Template Substitution
semantic_findings.description: Template values are inserted directly into content.xml, so XML metacharacters can corrupt documents or inject unintended ODF markup.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The sample uses direct string replacement and does not escape values or construct XML text nodes.

content.value_statement: Manual document conversion and repetitive Writer tasks consume time and produce inconsistent results. This skill provides practical LibreOffice, UNO, and Python workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of ODT documents with LibreOffice, UNO, or odfpy.
Provides commands for converting ODT, DOCX, PDF, HTML, RTF, TXT, and EPUB formats.
Explains batch conversion workflows for multiple documents.
Shows template-based generation by editing and repackaging ODT content.
Covers mail merge, forms, styles, tables, headers, and footers.
Provides troubleshooting guidance for headless LibreOffice automation.
limitations: Requires LibreOffice and relevant Python libraries to be installed separately.
Conversion fidelity depends on fonts, filters, document features, and the local LibreOffice version.
Examples require environment-specific paths, permissions, validation, and error handling.
The provided template substitution example does not safely escape XML values.

use_cases.title: Generate Standard Documents
use_cases.description: Create repeatable ODT templates for reports, letters, forms, and recurring business documents.

use_cases.title: Convert Document Archives
use_cases.description: Plan batch conversions between ODT, DOCX, PDF, and other supported formats.

use_cases.title: Build Writer Automation
use_cases.description: Design Python and UNO workflows that create, edit, and export Writer documents.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple ODT
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ODT document titled [title] with these sections: [sections]. Use accessible headings and consistent styles.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Format Conversion
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert [input file] from [source format] to [target format]. Preserve styles, list prerequisites, and verify the output.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Batch Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a safe batch workflow for converting [folder and pattern] to [format]. Include output handling, logs, failure recovery, and validation.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Template Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a secure Writer template pipeline using [data source]. Escape inserted values, preserve ODT structure, generate [formats], and test accessibility.

output_examples.input: Create a quarterly report in ODT with a title, summary, results table, and conclusion.
output_examples.output: A structured Writer document with styled headings, an accessible table, metadata, and a saved ODT source file.

output_examples.input: Convert all ODT files in the reports folder to PDF and record failures.
output: A batch conversion plan with explicit input and output folders.
A result log listing successful files, failed files, and validation checks.

output_examples.input: Generate personalized letters from a Writer template and spreadsheet data.
output_examples.output: A mail merge workflow that maps fields, creates one document per recipient, and validates missing values before export.

best_practices: Keep editable ODT sources and reusable templates under version control.
Validate layout, accessibility, fonts, and content after every format conversion.
Use structured XML or ODF APIs, isolated temporary directories, and explicit error handling.
anti_patterns: Do not insert unescaped user values directly into ODT XML.
Do not terminate every LibreOffice process when only one headless instance needs attention.
Do not assume conversion success without checking exit status and opening the output.

faq.question: Which document formats does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers ODT, DOCX, DOC, PDF, PDF/A, HTML, RTF, TXT, and EPUB, with direction varying by format.

faq.question: Does it install LibreOffice automatically?
faq.answer: No. LibreOffice, Python, UNO bindings, and optional ODF libraries must be available in the working environment.

faq.question: Can it process many documents?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides batch conversion patterns, but you must add validation, logging, and failure handling.

faq.question: Can it create mail merge documents?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance covers mail merge concepts with CSV, spreadsheet, or database data sources.

faq.question: Will converted documents preserve formatting exactly?
faq.answer: Not always. Fonts, advanced layout features, filters, and LibreOffice versions can affect conversion fidelity.

faq.question: Is the template replacement example safe for untrusted data?
faq.answer: No. Use an XML or ODF API that escapes inserted values before processing untrusted data.
